_source: Script v2 (design/script_v2.md d2, d5; applied 5 Oct 2026), from Blueprint Part M (popups), F1 (title), F3 (tip), G1 (village hover), H1 (page buttons), I (aftermath), L3 (summary). {placeholders} are filled in code.

audioUnlock.text: Audio is off. Enable audio for the full investigation?

evidenceTip.when: First time an investigation page opens
evidenceTip.text: Tip: Inspect loud words and strange objects to uncover evidence.

spiritLightTip.when: First time a memory page opens (after evidenceTip)
spiritLightTip.text: Hold L, or tap the lantern, to shine the spirit-light. Some things only show in the light.

investigationReady.when: A core deduction has enough evidence
investigationReady.text:
Enough evidence collected.
Reconstruct the event.

unsupported.when: Selected clues do not support the current conclusion
unsupported.text: None of this points there. Go back to the page.

newEvidence.when: A new relationship or clue appears

casebookFirstOpen.text:
Casebook - first clue pinned.
Follow the contradictions.

witnessStatus.when: Hovering a witness in the village

finalReconstruction.text: The evidence fits. Reconstruct the night.

truthRevealed.when: Silhouette and master record are revealed
truthRevealed.text: The investigator was part of the case.

closeness._when: B1: a wrong deduction says how close it was, never which card or option (Golden Idol style). Checked in this order; 'nothing right' uses popups.unsupported. A deduction's closeHint is added on a new line when its likely-miss conclusion is picked.
closeness.conclusionRightMissing: The conclusion fits. The evidence isn't complete.
closeness.conclusionRightExtra: The conclusion fits. One card doesn't belong.
closeness.conclusionRightExtraMany: The conclusion fits. Some cards don't belong.
closeness.conclusionRightMissingAndExtra: The conclusion fits. The cards need another look.
closeness.cardsFitConclusionWrong: The evidence holds. The conclusion doesn't.
closeness.someCardsFit: {right} of your {picked} cards belong. The conclusion doesn't fit.
closeness.nothingYet: Pick the clues and one conclusion first.

tutorial.firstClueCaption: Inspect the loud comic words and strange objects to uncover evidence.

summary.replayHint: Some evidence only shows in the light.
